item.title: Show HN: Jido Assembly; Slack Clone in Pure Elixir with Integrated Agents
item.summary: Hi HN! We put together a showcase on a group chat application in pure Elixir that includes the following: * Hologram UI * Jido Agents * Jido Messaging (bridging chat to Telegram/Discord) The authoring experience is pure Elixir on both the front end and back end. This showcase demonstrates the potency of this stack. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49170704 Points: 3 # Comments: 0
